notes.title: NMDC becomes PaperNomad
notes.content:
We have been working a lot and we are finally ready to show you the results!

More will come soon so stay tuned

notes.title: NMDC v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Nomads!
It has been a while , but we are back to bring you the first update to NMDC.
Come check it out, you'll find:
- Bug fix
- UI update
- Maps and Characters Import/Export
- New Props
- New Tiles
- New Character models
- Playable Orc race
- Added "Help" screen
Stay tuned for more!!!
Alex
